title: Burning Rate Emulator
summary: Gaseous burner tests that emulate the burning of solid and liquid fuels, using methane and ethylene at oxygen levels from 21% to 40%.
sensors_basis: The table summarises daily results; it names no instruments.

title: Electric Field Effects on Flames
summary: Applies a high-voltage electric field to microgravity flames. The ion wind mimics some effects of gravity, but this is NOT partial-gravity data.
sensors_basis: Mesh polarity is recorded (the field electrode), not a sensor.
embedded_notes: Fuel Conc. (diluted with nitrogen on a volume basis) was varied between tests, but typically matched the bottle. The list only accounts for flames ignited.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
summary: 129 solid-fuel tests: PMMA rods, films, slabs and spheres, SIBAL fabric, Nomex and a candle, at 13.6-22.2% oxygen in low-speed forced flow. Outcomes are transcribed from the BASS-II Summary Report.
objectives: BASS-II results contribute to the combustion computational models used in the design of fire detection and suppression systems in microgravity and on Earth. Objectives Include: 1) Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity. 2) Begin to bridge the gap between the normal gravity NASA-STD-6001 Test #1 method, ground-based microgravity tests, and actual material flammability in microgravity. 3) Provide SoFIE PIs with preliminary data to refine Science Requirements. 4) Practical, realistic (thicker) fuels in typical geometries will be examined, including slabs, cylinders, and spherical sections. The primary variables include: Forced flow velocity (speed and direction); Ambient oxygen concentration (via working volume nitrogen vitiation); Sample geometry (rods, spherical section, slabs, films, and fabric sheets)
sensors_basis: Columns for radiometer gain, calibrated O2/CO2/CO and frames shot; air display; CSA-CP and CDM units are named in Appendix A of the Summary Report (test T1).

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
summary: The first BASS campaign: 122 tests on PMMA spheres and slabs, SIBAL, Nomex, Ultem and wax. The experimental table records materials and dates only.
sensors_basis: The table records sample identity only.

title: Cool Flames Investigation
summary: 87 droplet tests of n-dodecane and dodecane/iso-dodecane blends at 0.5-5 atm and 17% or 21% oxygen, fibre-supported or free-floated.
sensors_basis: The table records conditions and fibre use; no instrument columns.

title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test
summary: Two sessions measuring Arizona Road Dust aerosol, relevant to how dust can confuse smoke detectors.
sensors_basis: Named in the Hardware Description column.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment 2
summary: Parameter ranges covered by FLEX-2 droplet tests. These 8 rows describe ranges, not individual tests; the per-test table is not in this dataset.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
summary: 274 methanol and heptane droplet tests with recorded outcomes, using carbon dioxide and helium as suppressants.
sensors_basis: Columns for initial and extinction diameter, burning rate, pressure and mole fractions.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment I
summary: Large-scale SIBAL fabric burns aboard an uncrewed Cygnus, comparing concurrent and opposed flame spread.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment II
summary: Nine samples of silicone, SIBAL, PMMA and Nomex. The only table here with BOTH microgravity and normal-gravity burn results for the same samples.
sensors_evidenced: CO₂ measurement (used to derive O₂, Note 1)
sensors_basis: Camera columns; Note 1 says O2 was derived from measured CO2 production.
embedded_notes: Note 1 Derived from measured CO2 production and referenced to initial O2 concentration reported by ISS.
Note 2 The PMMA portion was completely consumed but the Nomex was not ignited.
Note 3 This is the length of fuel with significant visible damage.
Note 4 The flames remain anchored at the base of the sample which has a very slow regression rate (0.01 to 0.04 mm/s)

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment III
summary: Two large-scale SIBAL fabric burns at 30 cm/s, concurrent and opposed. The table records conditions only.

title: Smoke Aging and Measurement Experiment (Reflight)
summary: 109 tests of how smoke particles grow as they age, from Kapton, silicone, lampwick, Teflon and Pyrell heated without flaming (pyrolysis smoke, not fire smoke).
sensors_basis: Named in the Description column (e.g. 'no Ptrak', 'STS det').

title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
summary: 469 gas-jet tests locating the smoke point (where a flame starts releasing soot) for ethylene, propane, propylene blends and methane across three nozzle sizes.
sensors_basis: Fuel rate and air rate columns.

title: Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
summary: 179 tests separating cool flames from hot ignition in ethane, propane and butane streams, with seven cool-flame regimes labelled PCI-A to PCI-G.
sensors_basis: PMT named in Comments; peak burner temperature and O2 before/after columns.
